dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: Knife? You call this a knife? ...It's a sword, obviously!

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: It's called the Dugu Longsword. The blacksmith made it specially for me.

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: He also thought of a motto for me: "Longsword in hand and the world at my feet"!

dialogues.speaker: Dugu Shuo
dialogues.text: He even inscribed it on the sword for me to make sure I don't forget it. Such a great guy!
